claims.text: The cancellation fee should not be collected, and this case must go to a human reviewer with a direction to refund it, because the driver's own profile trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check. EV-DPROF-00207 records driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 7 — four or more, the first limb — against 61 completed trips in the same trailing 30 days, a rate of 0.115, above the 0.08 threshold, the second limb. Both limbs are therefore met on this driver's own numbers. POL-NS-07 then does two things in the rider's favour: it withholds the driver's compensation, and it requires the case to escalate under POL-NS-09, with the escalation packet directing the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, the fee being held meanwhile rather than collected.

The disputed SGD 4.00 is not money the rider has paid and is not money the pipeline may take. EV-FARE-00207 records payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and charged_at null: the fee is on hold, not collected. Under POL-GEN-03 an ESCALATE holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it, and POL-NS-07 says in terms that the fee is held so that the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. The consequence of the escalation that this record compels is therefore that the rider is left not carrying the disputed charge while the reviewer settles the open question.

I do not dispute that the driver's in-geofence run is long. EV-GPS-00207 places him inside the arrival radius in a single unbroken run of 507 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is not where this case is won, and there is no shortfall for POL-NS-06 to work on. But POL-NS-01 is only the baseline chargeability test, and POL-NS-07 is applied on top of it: where POL-NS-01 is made out and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, the driver's compensation is STILL withheld and the case STILL escalates if the anti-farming check trips — and on this profile it trips. The driver therefore recovers nothing from this fare, and the direction carried into the escalation packet is that the rider's fee be refunded.

The figure the reviewer is directed to refund is the cancellation-fee line only. EV-FARE-00207 itemises cancellation_fee at SGD 4.00, with a computed difference of 0.00 against the fee schedule: the STANDARD zone-class fee is SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, and POL-NS-01's resolution rule takes the greater of the two, so the chargeable amount is SGD 4.00 and the refund direction covers the whole of it. The SGD 0.50 platform fee on the ledger is not part of the contested amount and is not sought.

The rider's side of this record must be read within POL-GEN-01. The profile counters that would colour a view of this rider — rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips, prior_disputes_filed, prior_no_show_flags (a lifetime figure of 2) — are context only and may not ground any finding, and prior_no_show_flags is expressly NOT the trailing-window counter. The only rider-side profile field in play in this category is rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d under POL-NS-09(d), and on EV-RPROF-00207 it stands at 1, nowhere near the 3 that limb requires; the rider also shows 0 disputes with this counterparty in 90 days under POL-NS-09(c). Nothing on the rider's profile supports an adverse finding, and the escalation that decides this case is triggered from the driver's profile.

I will not overstate the rider's own account. The rider track in EV-GPS-00207 carries 118 fixes, none of them qualifying, stationary between 1,894 m and 1,907 m from the pickup pin, so the assertion in the claim that the rider came down is not corroborated by the record, and this is not a POL-NS-04 case: no message in EV-CHAT-00207 was sent by the rider, and the driver both messaged from 06:42:30 and placed an in-app call at 06:45:10 that went unanswered. I put that concession on the table rather than stretch it. It does not decide the fee, because the route this case actually turns on — the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check and the POL-NS-09 escalation it compels — is driven by the driver's 30-day no-show record, not by whether the rider was standing at the block.

claims.text: The trip record for TRP-00207 contains a driver 'arrived' event at 06:41:20 and records no boarding event anywhere on the trip. POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the record.

The GPS trace puts the driver's first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:41:10, ten seconds BEFORE the recorded 'arrived' event, inside the 50 m arrival radius that the fee schedule sets for a STANDARD zone, with 52 qualifying fixes, 100 percent coverage and no sampling gaps at all. POL-NS-01 limb (b), read with POL-NS-02, is satisfied because the driver was in the geofence at or before the arrival timestamp.

The driver held position inside the geofence continuously for 507 seconds, measured from the first qualifying fix at 06:41:10 to the cancellation at 06:49:37 - that is 207 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum dwell the fee schedule requires for a STANDARD pickup. POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied, and it does not matter that the 'arrived' tap itself was slightly after GPS entry, because the clause measures the dwell from the first qualifying fix.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 06:49:37, after the required dwell had fully elapsed, with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, and no boarding event is recorded. POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. The chat log holds four entries and not one of them was sent by the rider - the rider sent no locating or coordinating message at all, so limb (a) of POL-NS-04 fails; and the driver placed an in-app call at 06:45:10 which was never answered, so limb (b) fails as well, independently of the silence.

The rider was not at the pickup point. The rider's own device track sits roughly 1.9 km from the pin for the entire waiting window and returns zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, and the rider's claim to have 'come down' a few minutes late is contradicted by his own telemetry.

There is no false arrival marker here. At the recorded arrival the driver was already inside the geofence - his closest approach to the pin across the trip was 14.5 m - and the trace shows him holding position in the qualifying run. He was therefore neither more than 300 m from the pin nor travelling at 15 km/h or above when the marker was set, so POL-NS-05 does not displace the fee.

This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03 either: the driver's qualifying stationary fixes fall inside the 50 m arrival radius at the registered pickup pin itself, not in the 50-400 m band that clause governs, so nothing in POL-NS-03 refunds this fee or opens a goodwill payment.

POL-NS-06's shortfall route is closed: the effective in-geofence dwell of 507 seconds exceeds the 300-second STANDARD minimum, so no part of the fee is refundable on shortfall grounds. I note for completeness that the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is absent - it has no payload and carries weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - but the driver does not need dwell accumulated across separate intervals, so that absence does not bear on this outcome one way or the other.

The charged fee reconciles with the fee schedule and raises no integrity defect: the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00) is $4.00, and the fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line reads exactly $4.00. POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged on this record.

POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of the $4.00 cancellation fee, that is $3.20, and the fee itself stands as itemised in the fare breakdown. On the substance of this trip the rider's demand for his $4.00 back fails.

I disclose, because the policy obliges completeness here, that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check trips on this driver's profile: 7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 61 completed trips is 11.5 percent, meeting both the 4-or-more count limb and the greater-than-0.08 rate limb. The consequence the clause fixes is that compensation is withheld and the case is sent to escalation under POL-NS-09(d), which is terminal for the automated pipeline and holds the $4.00 fee rather than collecting or refunding it. That is a profile-based limit on the driver's payout, not a finding about this trip, and the merits of the trip itself lie with the driver.

No other POL-NS-09 trigger is met: both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0 and the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the threshold of 3, so the escalation on this record rests solely on the POL-NS-07 anti-farming limb. The rider's prior_no_show_flags of 2 is a lifetime counter, context only under POL-GEN-01, and is not the field POL-NS-09(d) reads.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: on the merits of this trip the record is against you, and your demand for the SGD 4.00 back is not supported. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00207 (weight 1.0, 100% coverage, no gaps) places the driver inside the 50 m arrival radius for Blk 682 Woodlands Ave 6 from 06:41:10 continuously to the cancellation at 06:49:37 — a single unbroken 507-second hold, 207 seconds longer than the 300-second minimum the fee schedule requires for a STANDARD pickup. The trip record EV-TRIP-00207 (weight 1.0) records the arrival event at 06:41:20, the driver's termination at 06:49:37 with reason RIDER_NO_SHOW, and no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore met, POL-NS-02 confirms the driver was inside the geofence, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee (the driver was 14.5 m from the pin when he marked arrival, so POL-NS-05 raises no false-arrival point; there is no shortfall for POL-NS-06; and this was not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03). The record does not corroborate that you came down: your own device's track in EV-GPS-00207 sits about 1.9 km from the pin for the entire waiting window with no qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius, and no message in the chat log EV-CHAT-00207 (weight 1.0) was sent by you, while the driver both messaged at 06:42:30 and placed an unanswered in-app call at 06:45:10 — so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you either. To the driver: you met every condition the fee depends on, and the amount reconciles with the schedule — the GREATER of the SGD 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, matching the cancellation_fee line in EV-FARE-00207 (weight 1.0). But POL-NS-07's anti-farming check reads your own trailing-30-day numbers on EV-DPROF-00207 (weight 1.0): 7 no-show terminations against 61 completed trips, a rate of 11.5%. That is both 4-or-more and greater than 0.08, so both limbs are met, your compensation is WITHHELD and the case must go to a human reviewer under POL-NS-09(d). This is a pattern check on your last 30 days, not a finding that this trip was fabricated — on this trip the record is with you. Outcome: the case is ESCALATED and no money moves now. The disputed SGD 4.00 is neither collected nor refunded; EV-FARE-00207 shows payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and charged_at null, so the fee stays on hold while review is pending. Your SGD 3.20 compensation (80% of SGD 4.00) is not paid. Per POL-NS-07 the reviewer is directed to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full if the escalation resolves in the rider's favour. The riders' and driver's remaining claims on the same points are answered together above: both sides' POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 claims are accepted, both sides' POL-NS-07 anti-farming and POL-NS-09(d) claims are accepted and are what decide this case, and the rider's point that the fee is held rather than collected is accepted. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is disclosed but carries no fact and is needed by no clause here, since the dwell already exceeds the minimum without accumulation. The profile fields rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate, prior_disputes_filed, prior_no_show_flags and the like were raised only to be disclaimed as context-only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as any ground of decision.
referrals: POL-NS-07: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full, the fee being held meanwhile rather than collected or refunded (the anti-farming check has tripped, so the driver's compensation is withheld and the case is escalated under POL-NS-09(d)).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer, and the SGD 4.00 no-show fee stays on hold while that happens — neither collected from the rider nor refunded — because EV-FARE-00207 records payment_status PENDING, charged_at null and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. Escalation is terminal, so no money moves under this ruling and the packet carries the review instruction below. Confidence is 0.90, above the platform floor of 0.70, and every fact the ruling rests on comes from an artifact at weight 1.0.

On the trip itself, the driver's account holds and the rider's does not. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00207 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 06:41:10 — ten seconds before the recorded arrival event at 06:41:20 (EV-TRIP-00207) — with 52 qualifying fixes, 100% coverage and no sampling gaps, and shows him holding position for 507 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum before cancelling at 06:49:37 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 (limbs a to d) are therefore satisfied, and none of the displacing clauses applies: POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) because the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not in the 50–400 m band; POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) because the rider sent no message in EV-CHAT-00207 and the driver both messaged from 06:42:30 and placed an unanswered in-app call at 06:45:10; POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) because at the marker the driver was within the geofence (closest approach 14.5 m) and stationary, not over 300 m away or moving at 15 km/h; and POL-NS-06 (waiting shortfall) because the measured dwell of 507 seconds exceeds the 300-second STANDARD minimum by 207 seconds. The charge itself reconciles: the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is SGD 4.00, matching the fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

The rider's claim that he 'came down, just a few minutes later' is not corroborated. His own device track in EV-GPS-00207 carries 118 fixes stationary roughly 1.9 km from the pin (between 1,894 m and 1,907 m) across the whole waiting window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, and he wrote nothing in the chat log. His demand for the SGD 4.00 back fails on the merits of the trip.

The reason the fee does not simply stand, and the reason the driver recovers nothing despite being right about the trip, is POL-NS-07's anti-farming check, which runs on the driver's own profile and meets both of its limbs on EV-DPROF-00207: 7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days (the limb requires 4 or more) against 61 completed trips in the same window, a rate of 11.5% (the limb requires above 8%). POL-NS-07 therefore withholds the driver's SGD 3.20 (80% of the SGD 4.00 fee) and sends the case to escalation under POL-NS-09(d). I stress that this is a profile-based limit on the payout, not a finding against the driver on this trip, and that the rider's own side of the record is clean: the only rider-side counter this category reads, no_show_disputes_30d, stands at 1 (below the 3 that POL-NS-09(d) requires) and the parties show 0 disputes with each other in 90 days (POL-NS-09(c)). No other escalation limb is met, and confidence is not below the floor. The open question for the reviewer is the driver's 30-day no-show pattern, and the packet directs the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line in full; the SGD 0.50 platform fee is not part of the contested amount.
referrals: POL-NS-07: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full; the fee is held under POL-NS-09 while review is pending.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This case is escalated to a human reviewer and no money moves now; the SGD 4.00 is held (EV-FARE-00207 records payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, charged_at null), neither collected nor refunded, while the review is pending.

What the record shows. On the merits of the trip, POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs, and the driver-side claims on those limbs are accepted. EV-TRIP-00207 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 06:41:20 (limb (a)). EV-GPS-00207 puts the driver's first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:41:10, ten seconds before that event, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with 52 qualifying fixes and 100% coverage and no sampling gaps (limb (b), read with POL-NS-02).
